rights_policy.rule: Omniva operator publications, AKS postal assignments and areas, ADS address/building objects, and EHAK boundaries remain independently versioned evidence artifacts.
rights_policy.attribution: Every public artifact records provider, dataset or service, edition or retrieval time, validity date, schema, CRS, digest, transformation and requested attribution.

sources.production_scope: Pinned operator pages, downloads and query receipts within applicable terms; shipment, recipient and customer data are outside the pack.
sources.terms_note: Omniva is the postal-code manager. Public search and downloads establish operator evidence but do not by themselves grant unrestricted bulk redistribution or define geometry.

sources.provider: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
sources.production_scope: Pinned monthly current-address CSV and versioned AKS query receipts with provider attribution, extraction date, schema and digest.
sources.terms_note: Postal codes are managed by Omniva and attached to official addresses according to Omniva zones. The monthly CSV contains only current address versions.

sources.provider: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
sources.production_scope: Pinned AKS OGC postal-area snapshot with service generation, layer name, schema, CRS, retrieval time, attribution, digest and topology report.
sources.terms_note: AKS publishes postal-code areas based on Omniva-managed zones. Geometry and address assignments are still validated and versioned as separate artifacts.

sources.provider: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
sources.production_scope: Pinned monthly open-data extracts and versioned AKS REST or query receipts with provider attribution, object types, history and digest.
sources.terms_note: ADS/AKS contains official addresses based on local-government administrative acts. ADS_OID identifies an object across versions; ADOB_ID identifies a version.

sources.provider: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
sources.production_scope: Pinned AKS OGC building snapshot with object identifiers, service generation, layer schema, CRS, retrieval time, attribution and digest.
sources.terms_note: ADS building geometry can be definitive when the address and shape follow the same source object. Nearest geometry without that path stays a candidate.

sources.provider: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board and Statistics Estonia
sources.production_scope: Pinned monthly 1:10,000 administrative and settlement edition with EHAK codes, provider and validity-date attribution, CRS and digest.
sources.terms_note: EHAK attribute data and administrative geometry provide context. They neither assign postcodes nor replace AKS postal areas.

artifact_partitions.rule: Operator search, downloads, addressing rules and facility routing remain separately rights-reviewed receipts and artifacts.
Monthly current-only assignments retain ADR_ID, full address, postcode, reference coordinate semantics, release date, digest and attribution.
Postal polygons retain OGC generation, layer schema, CRS, retrieval time, digest, attribution and topology report.
Address objects retain ADS_OID, ADOB_ID, type, status, legal basis, validity, predecessor and successor without destructive overwrite.
Building points and polygons retain object identifiers and are definitive only through a coherent address-object path.
Administrative geometry retains EHAK edition and attribution and never inherits postal authority.
Public artifacts exclude occupants, owners, recipient data, private unit context, shipment data and delivery instructions.
Non-geographic fixtures only; never promotion evidence.
